paragraphs: R. Yehudah bar Sinna, in R. Acha's name: Eikhah Midrash, on “All her people groan.” [The checked passage reads Yehudah ben Signa.] R. Yehudah bar Sisin and R. Yehudah ben Pazi, in R. Acha's name: Jerusalem Kiddushin, chapter 3, halakhah 3. See and understand that they are all one. [This is Heilprin’s identification. The checked Kiddushin passage lists the two names side by side.]
